program='''def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    pts = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(g) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    minr = min(i for i, j in pts)
    minc = min(j for i, j in pts)
    shape = [(i - minr, j - minc) for i, j in pts]
    mh = max(i for i, j in shape) + 1
    mw = max(j for i, j in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h - mh + 1):
        for c in range(w - mw + 1):
            if all(g[r + i][c + j] == 0 for i, j in shape):
                for i, j in shape:
                    out[r + i][c + j] = 8
    return out
'''
